title: Understanding the Condition
text: To find the nuggets with weight less than $$0.6$$ ounces, you need to filter the DataFrame using a condition. Think about how you can use the column name and a comparison operator to achieve this.

title: Choosing the Correct Condition
text: Which of the following conditions correctly filters nuggets with weight less than $$0.6$$ ounces?

title: Filtering the DataFrame
text: Once you have the condition, apply it to the DataFrame to filter out the rows where the weight is less than $$0.6$$ ounces. This will give you a subset of the original DataFrame.
